coreBackstory: Jasper appeared in town six months ago, claiming to be a traveling bard collecting stories.
greetings: Ah, a new face! Or is it? I have a terrible memory for faces, but an excellent one for stories.
Welcome, welcome! Sit, listen, and if you're inspired, toss a coin. Or don't. The music's free.
You look like someone with a tale to tell. I'm all ears — and I've got excellent ones.
idleChatter: I've been composing a new ballad. It's about a hero, a curse, and a very unhelpful prophecy.
This town has more secrets than a bard could sing in a lifetime. Lucky for you, I'm persistent.
They say music soothes the savage beast. I say it soothes the savage landlord. Same principle.
I've performed in castles and gutters. Give me a warm fire and a willing audience — that's all I need.
farewells: May your road be smooth and your enemies be slightly less competent than you!
If you hear a song about a mysterious stranger, that's probably me. Don't applaud too loud.
Stay safe out there. And if you find a good story, bring it back. I'll put it to music.
reactiveComments: You've got the look of someone who's seen the other side of a fight. Want to talk about it? I'll put it to verse.
I've heard rumors about those ruins. Want me to sing you the warning ballad? It's catchy AND informative.
You're not the only one asking questions around here. Be careful who's listening.
